caption:
Persistent thermal monitoring flags heat anomalies along a pipeline corridor — signatures consistent with illegal refining or line-tapping activity that would not show up in optical imagery under cover of night or smoke.

The limit: each pass is a snapshot, not a feed. Between scheduled revisits, a refining site can stand up and strike camp before the next collection window. The system tells you where to look at the next opportunity. It cannot watch the corridor in real time.

Assessed: thermal anomaly consistent with heat-generating activity. Unknown: what happens in the gap between passes. Confirmed: only what ground teams verify on arrival.
thread: Persistent thermal monitoring flags heat anomalies along a pipeline corridor — signatures consistent with illegal refining or line-tapping, even under night or smoke cover.
The limit: each pass is a snapshot, not a feed. Between scheduled revisits, a site can stand up and strike camp before the next collection window.
This is cueing, not real-time surveillance. It narrows where a patrol should go next. It does not replace the patrol.
Assessed: thermal anomaly. Unknown: activity in the revisit gap. Confirmed: only what ground teams verify on arrival.

card.headline: It sees the heat. Not the gap between passes
card.sub: Thermal anomalies cue where to look next. Between scheduled revisits, a site can rise and disappear before the next collection window.

rationale: Introduces a new capability (thermal cueing for pipeline theft) not covered in prior posts, while holding the line on the periodic-not-continuous limit that builds credibility with operators who already know satellites don't watch continuously.
